title: Knapper configuration
description: Configuration for the knapper CLI and its vault-level commands.

vault_path.description: Vault path, resolved relative to the directory containing this file.

template_engine.description: Template expansion engine used by daily notes.

exclude.description: Vault-relative path prefixes omitted from whole-vault commands.

ignore_links.description: Whole link targets that are intentionally unresolved.

rules.description: Per-check settings. Every check is enabled by default.

folder.description: Folder where daily notes are created.

template.description: Vault-relative template path for newly created daily notes.

format.description: Date format used in daily-note paths.

default_file.description: Where tasks new writes by default: daily, inbox, or a path.

inbox.description: Vault-relative inbox path for tasks new.

created_date.description: Whether tasks new adds a created date.

created_date_format.description: Format for the created date appended to new tasks.

statuses.description: Built-in status overrides and user-defined task statuses.

enabled.description: Include this check in a plain knapper lint run.

include.description: Optional vault-relative path prefixes covered by this check.

exclude.description: Vault-relative path prefixes excluded from this check.

char.description: The single checkbox character for this status.

closed.description: Whether this status counts as closed.

date_format.description: Date marker stamped when a task enters this status; null disables stamping.
